front.title: AEGIS-based Cipher Suites for TLS 1.3, DTLS 1.3, and QUIC

abstract.t:
This document proposes new cipher suites based on the AEGIS family of authenticated encryption with associated data (AEAD) algorithms. The suites integrate AEGIS into TLS 1.3, DTLS 1.3, and QUIC.
About This Document
This note is to be removed before publishing as an RFC.
Status information for this document may be found at https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/draft-denis-tls-aegis/.
Source for this draft and an issue tracker can be found at https://github.com/jedisct1/draft-denis-tls-aegis.
